title: Billing-Delay Concession Schedule for Catch-Up Upgrade Charges
content:
Concession rates of 0.25 and 0.10 apply to a Rental Property Service Contracts catch-up charge for a tier upgrade according to the days that have passed between the upgrade date and the day the catch-up is billed.

| Days passed between the upgrade date and the day the catch-up is billed | Billing-delay concession |
|---|---|
| more than 120 | 0.25 |
| more than 60 but no more than 120 | 0.10 |
| 60 or fewer | 0 |

The upgrade date is the plan change date on the contract. The days passed are the calendar days from the upgrade date to the billing day.

**How the concession acts.** The concession is a reduction rate on the catch-up charge. Every reduction rate the charge carries is subtracted from one in a single sum, and the charge is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

## Boundaries

| Days passed | Concession |
|---|---|
| 60 | 0 |
| 61 | 0.10 |
| 120 | 0.10 |
| 121 | 0.25 |

*Hypothetical:* an upgrade on 1 February billed by catch-up on 15 July has 164 days passed: concession 0.25, so this rate alone leaves 0.75 of the charge.
